originalTitle: Submersos: O Drama de Famílias Atingidas
overview: Two years after the floods that struck Rio Grande do Sul in May 2024, a group of young people reconnects with two families whose lives were profoundly shaped by the tragedy. Through their accounts, the documentary seeks to understand how the event transformed their lives, what scars have persisted over time, and, above all, how family support proved essential in facing hardships and rebuilding their stories. More than just revisiting a tragedy, the film offers a look at family bonds, unity, and the importance of having someone to rely on during the most difficult moments. It is a reflection on the aftermath of an event that did not end when the waters receded—but also on the strength found within the family itself to keep moving forward.
tagline: When everything is lost, family becomes a shelter.
title: Submerged: The Plight of Affected Families
